views.name: anchors
views.definition:
SELECT chain_name,
    last_pruned_id,
    last_pruned_entry_hash,
    last_pruned_at
   FROM audit_chain_anchor
  WHERE chain_name ~ '^ops-activity-v1/[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text;

views.name: prunable_logs
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    chain_name,
    activity_observed_us,
    octet_length(request_params) AS encoded_bytes,
    entry_hash
   FROM access_logs
  WHERE activity_kind = 1 AND chain_name ~ '^ops-activity-v1/[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text;

views.name: qualified_logs
views.definition:
SELECT l.id,
    l.external_id,
    l.method,
    l.status_code,
    l.ip_address,
    l.created_at,
    l.correlation_id,
    l.request_params,
    l.entry_hash,
    l.response_status,
    l.hash_format_version,
    l.buffer_seq,
    l.chain_name,
    l.org_id,
    l.activity_run_id,
    l.activity_producer_id,
    l.activity_kind,
    l.activity_ordinal,
    l.activity_observed_us,
    l.activity_record_id,
    l.activity_outcome
   FROM access_logs l
     JOIN ops_activity_v1.runs r ON l.activity_run_id = r.run_id AND l.activity_producer_id = r.producer_id AND l.chain_name = r.chain_name
  WHERE l.activity_kind IS NOT NULL AND l.buffer_seq > (r.range_index * '1099511627776'::bigint) AND l.buffer_seq <= (r.range_index * '1099511627776'::bigint + '1099511627775'::bigint);

triggers.name: activity_delete_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER activity_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON access_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ops_activity_v1.guard_delete()

triggers.name: activity_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER activity_guard BEFORE INSERT ON access_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ops_activity_v1.guard_log()

triggers.name: activity_update_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER activity_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON access_logs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ops_activity_v1.guard_update()

functions.name: ops_activity_v1.guard_delete()
ops_activity_v1.guard_log()
ops_activity_v1.guard_update()
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops_activity_v1.guard_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF OLD.chain_name~'^ops-activity-v1/' OR NEW.chain_name~'^ops-activity-v1/' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'activity rows immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

constraints.name: runs_network_key_chain_name_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (network_key, chain_name) REFERENCES ops_activity_v1.sources(network_key, chain_name)

constraints.name: sources_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (head_id = 0 AND head_hash = ''::text OR head_id > 0 AND head_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)

constraints.name: activity_run_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (activity_run_id, activity_producer_id, chain_name) REFERENCES ops_activity_v1.runs(run_id, producer_id, chain_name)

constraints.name: activity_variant
constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN activity_kind IS NULL THEN activity_run_id IS NULL AND activity_producer_id IS NULL AND activity_ordinal IS NULL AND activity_observed_us IS NULL AND activity_record_id IS NULL AND activity_outcome IS NULL AND chain_name !~ '^ops-activity-v1/'::text
    ELSE activity_run_id IS NOT NULL AND activity_producer_id IS NOT NULL AND activity_kind = 1 AND activity_ordinal IS NOT NULL AND activity_ordinal > 0 AND activity_observed_us IS NOT NULL AND activity_observed_us >= 0 AND activity_observed_us <= '253402300799999999'::bigint AND activity_record_id IS NOT NULL AND activity_outcome IS NOT NULL AND chain_name ~ '^ops-activity-v1/[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND hash_format_version = 2 AND buffer_seq IS NOT NULL AND buffer_seq > 0 AND entry_hash IS NOT NULL AND entry_hash::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND request_params IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(request_params) >= 1 AND octet_length(request_params) <= 2048 AND created_at IS NOT NULL AND response_status IS NOT NULL AND ip_address IS NOT NULL AND correlation_id::text = activity_record_id::text AND denial_reason IS NULL
END)
